description: Corporate KPI rollup across all domains.

list.name: factory
list.label: Factory
list.definition: SELECT name AS "__text", code AS "__value" FROM factories WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY name
list.query: SELECT name AS "__text", code AS "__value" FROM factories WHERE "isActive" = true ORDER BY name

list.name: area
list.label: Area
list.definition: SELECT a.name AS "__text", a.id AS "__value" FROM areas a JOIN factories f ON f.id = a."factoryId" WHERE ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') ORDER BY a.name
list.query: SELECT a.name AS "__text", a.id AS "__value" FROM areas a JOIN factories f ON f.id = a."factoryId" WHERE ('$factory' = '' OR f.code = '$factory') ORDER BY a.name

targets.rawSql:
WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE((LEAST(100,100.0*run/NULLIF(ppt,0)))*(LEAST(100,100.0*earned/NULLIF(run,0)))*(100.0*good/NULLIF(good+scrap,0))/10000,0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(good+scrap,0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t
    WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart") AND ('$factory'='' OR t."factoryId" IN (SELECT id FROM factories WHERE code='$factory'))
    AND ('$area'='' OR t."areaId"='$area')
    AND ('$line'='' OR t."lineId"='$line')
    AND ('$machine'='' OR t."machineId"='$machine')),
  fin AS (SELECT wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY wo),
  agg AS (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                 COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
          FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.wo=s.wo) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(100.0*good/NULLIF(good+scrap,0),0)::numeric,2) AS value FROM agg
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM ncrs t WHERE t.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')
SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM maintenance_wos t WHERE t.status IN ('OPEN','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') AND t."deletedAt" IS NULL
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(t.value),0)::numeric,0) AS value FROM energy_readings t WHERE $__timeFilter(t."timestamp")

WITH scoped AS (
    SELECT t."factoryId" fid, t."workOrderId" wo, t."sequenceOrder" seq, t."goodBase" gb, t."scrapBase" sb,
           t."plannedMin" pm, t."runMin" rm, t."idealRunMin" irm
    FROM production_snapshots t WHERE t.granularity='MINUTE' AND $__timeFilter(t."bucketStart")),
  fin AS (SELECT fid, wo, MAX(seq) ms FROM scoped GROUP BY fid, wo),
  factagg AS (SELECT s.fid, COALESCE(SUM(s.gb) FILTER (WHERE s.seq=f.ms),0) good, COALESCE(SUM(s.sb),0) scrap,
                     COALESCE(SUM(s.pm),0) ppt, COALESCE(SUM(s.rm),0) run, COALESCE(SUM(s.irm),0) earned
              FROM scoped s JOIN fin f ON f.fid=s.fid AND f.wo=s.wo GROUP BY s.fid) SELECT fa.name AS "Factory", ROUND(((LEAST(100,100.0*run/NULLIF(ppt,0)))*(LEAST(100,100.0*earned/NULLIF(run,0)))*(100.0*good/NULLIF(good+scrap,0))/10000)::numeric,1) AS "OEE %", ROUND((good+scrap)::numeric,0) AS "Output", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ncrs n WHERE n."factoryId"=fa.id AND n.status NOT IN ('RESOLVED','CLOSED')) AS "Open NCRs", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM maintenance_wos mw WHERE mw."factoryId"=fa.id AND mw.status IN ('OPEN','ASSIGNED','IN_PROGRESS') AND mw."deletedAt" IS NULL) AS "Open Maint" FROM factagg JOIN factories fa ON fa.id=factagg.fid ORDER BY 2 DESC
